    Wq=W[f'W_q.{l}'].reshape(H,D,896); Wk=W[f'W_k.{l}'].reshape(G,D,896)

    return Wq,Wk,bq,bk

    # qv (...,64), kv(...,64); score of query at m, key at m-delta
    a,b=qv[...,:32],qv[...,32:]; c,d=kv[...,:32],kv[...,32:]

    A=a*c+b*d; B=a*d-b*c
    ang=np.outer(deltas,inv)

    XN[l,h]=np.sqrt(abs(np.trace((Qw[l,h]@Qw[l,h].T)@(K[l,h]@K[l,h].T))))
